external_benchmark_notice: References describe real programs/evidence; SELF thresholds and rubric are independently designed internal criteria, never named firm approval.

teach_contract.naming_rule: Immediately after every analogy include a sentence like 'Yes, ini namanya [English technical term] ([Indonesian term])'. Distinguish neighboring and commonly confused terms, do not force a false synonym.
teach_contract.audience_language: Bahasa Indonesia ringan + accepted English technical terms. Define abbreviations on first use and retain them for interviews.
teach_contract.analogy_quality: Concrete, numerically accurate when numbers appear; identify where analogy stops matching professional use. Never substitute analogy for rigorous definition.
teach_contract.visual_rule: Prefer authentic licensed/attributed exhibit. Every original evidence page requires source URL, publisher, page/section, access status, and an evidence-to-claim check. Missing images must not be replaced with fake screenshots.
teach_contract.video_rule: Each assigned video must have verified creator/URL/objective, and a named action to perform immediately afterward. Chapters only when source verified.
teach_contract.examples_rule: A worked example is explicitly separate from independent answer keys; answers must not leak into blank modeling assessment.
teach_contract.competency_rule: No 'Watched = Mastered'. End with a new question or numeric exercise with identifiable expected outcome.
teach_contract.assistance_rule: Three levels: concept reminder; methodology/formula guidance; reference solution only after student tries. Track hints used when interpreting independent performance.
teach_contract.feedback_rule: Feedback cites failing cell, calculation, reason, evidence or assumption. Encourage revision and repeated independent attempt instead of generic praise.
teach_contract.memory_rule: Review core technical terms again in a separate session / later case; include retrieval practice and spaced practice.

glossary.analogy: Harga toko keseluruhan berbeda dari uang bersih pemilik setelah utangnya dibereskan.
glossary.definition: EV adalah nilai operasi perusahaan bagi semua penyandang dana; Equity Value adalah nilai yang menjadi hak pemegang saham setelah penyesuaian utang/kas dan klaim lain yang relevan.
glossary.numbers: EV Rp120M, net debt Rp40M -> equity value Rp80M.
glossary.check: Apakah menambah Rp10M kas mengubah enterprise value, equity value, atau kedua-duanya, jika faktor lain tetap?

glossary.analogy: Modal sendiri seperti uang DP rumah; sisanya pinjam bank.
glossary.term: Capital Structure / Debt Financing / Equity Contribution
glossary.definition: Capital structure menjelaskan komposisi pendanaan melalui utang dan modal pemegang saham.
glossary.numbers: Harga Rp100M, debt Rp60M -> equity kontribusi Rp40M sebelum biaya.
glossary.check: Apa risiko investor jika arus kas perusahaan turun?

glossary.analogy: Membeli bisnis dengan sebagian dana pinjaman untuk menghasilkan pengembalian kepada pemegang saham.
glossary.definition: Akuisisi dengan porsi pembiayaan utang yang material, ditopang cash flow bisnis target.
glossary.numbers: EV Rp100M, debt Rp60M, equity Rp40M (simplified, no fees).
glossary.check: Mengapa leverage tidak selalu meningkatkan IRR?

glossary.analogy: Dua sisi nota belanja harus cocok: asal uang sama dengan dipakainya.
glossary.definition: Tabel transaksi yang merekonsiliasi seluruh sumber dana dengan seluruh penggunaan dana.
glossary.numbers: Uses Rp120M+fee Rp4M, debt Rp60M -> equity Rp64M.
glossary.check: Berapa funding gap ketika sources baru Rp121M?

glossary.analogy: Laba di atas kertas belum sama dengan uang yang bisa dipakai membayar tagihan.
glossary.definition: Working capital operasional mencerminkan dana yang terikat dalam persediaan/piutang dikurangi kewajiban operasional terkait; kenaikan modal kerja biasanya menggunakan kas.
glossary.numbers: Piutang naik Rp7M dengan faktor lain tetap -> CFO turun Rp7M.
glossary.check: Mengapa pertumbuhan penjualan bisa memperburuk arus kas?

glossary.analogy: Laba operasi sebelum beberapa biaya tertentu, bukan uang tunai.
glossary.definition: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization; ukuran kinerja operasi yang mengabaikan biaya tertentu, bukan pengganti free cash flow.
glossary.numbers: EBITDA Rp20M, capex Rp8M tidak berarti investor punya Rp20M kas.
glossary.check: Apa dua pengeluaran yang tidak tercermin langsung dalam EBITDA?

glossary.analogy: Setiap tahun sisa pinjaman harus diperbarui seperti cicilan kredit.
glossary.definition: Perhitungan saldo utang awal, pencairan, bunga, pembayaran pokok dan saldo utang akhir.
glossary.numbers: Utang awal Rp60M, pelunasan pokok Rp8M -> akhir Rp52M.
glossary.check: Apakah biaya bunga otomatis mengurangi pokok utang?

glossary.analogy: Tabel 'kalau harga jual turun, untungku jadi berapa?'
glossary.definition: Pengujian dampak perubahan asumsi pada valuation, cash, return atau kelayakan keputusan.
glossary.numbers: Exit multiple 8x, 10x, 12x menghasilkan exit EV berbeda.
glossary.check: Asumsi exit multiple naik terus tanpa bukti termasuk risiko apa?

glossary.analogy: Uang Rp1 menjadi Rp2 berarti hasil dua kali lipat, tetapi belum jelas berapa cepat.
glossary.definition: Gross proceeds divided by invested equity capital, sebelum definisi fee/expense khusus yang relevan.
glossary.numbers: Equity out Rp50M, exit equity Rp125M -> MOIC 2.5x.
glossary.check: MOIC 2.5x dalam 3 tahun sama menariknya dengan 10 tahun?

glossary.analogy: Mengukur kecepatan pertumbuhan modal dengan mempertimbangkan waktu.
glossary.definition: Discount rate yang membuat NPV seluruh arus kas investasi menjadi nol.
glossary.numbers: Invest 100, receive 121 after 2 years -> IRR 10% pa.
glossary.check: Mengapa MOIC dan IRR perlu dibaca bersama?

glossary.analogy: Berapa harga tertinggi yang masih membuat bisnis layak dibeli.
glossary.definition: Harga akuisisi maksimum yang konsisten dengan persyaratan return investor di bawah asumsi tertentu.
glossary.numbers: Hurdle 20% IRR -> cari entry price yang menghasilkan tepat sekitar 20%.
glossary.check: Apa yang terjadi pada maksimum harga masuk ketika proyeksi EBITDA turun?

glossary.analogy: Seperti kolam: semua orang Indonesia bukan otomatis calon pembeli produk khusus mahasiswa.
glossary.definition: Total addressable market, serviceable available market, serviceable obtainable market; ukur ruang pasar berjenjang.
glossary.numbers: TAM Rp10T tidak berarti startup bisa memperoleh Rp10T.
glossary.check: Bagaimana menunjukkan reachable share tanpa asal mengalikan pangsa pasar?

glossary.analogy: Pendapatan langganan seperti iuran bulanan, bukan seluruh uang transfer yang masuk.
glossary.definition: Monthly / Annual Recurring Revenue, diukur dari kontrak/langganan berulang dengan penyesuaian relevan.
glossary.numbers: MRR Rp100jt -> ARR run-rate Rp1,2Miliar, belum tentu revenue tahun aktual.
glossary.check: Apa beda annualized run rate dan actual revenue?

glossary.analogy: Anak kelas yang daftar bersamaan diamati bulan demi bulan.
glossary.definition: Mengelompokkan pelanggan berdasarkan waktu masuk untuk mempelajari perilaku, retention dan monetization pada usia pelanggan yang sebanding.
glossary.numbers: 100 signup Januari, 80 aktif pada bulan 6 -> logo retention 80%.
glossary.check: Bolehkah langsung membandingkan cohort umur 3 bulan dan 6 bulan?

glossary.analogy: Dari 10 pelanggan berbayar, dua pergi: berapa yang bertahan?
glossary.definition: Perbandingan jumlah pelanggan yang bertahan/hilang dari awal periode.
glossary.numbers: 100 awal, 80 bertahan -> retention 80%, churn 20%.
glossary.check: Apa bedanya churn pelanggan dan churn revenue?

glossary.analogy: Pelanggan lama mungkin pergi, tetapi yang bertahan belanja makin besar.
glossary.definition: Recurring revenue dari pelanggan yang sama setelah churn, contraction dan expansion; tidak memasukkan revenue pelanggan baru.
glossary.numbers: MRR awal 100, expansion 20, contraction 5, churn 10 -> NRR 105%.
glossary.check: Mengapa NRR >100% belum membuktikan startup profitable?

glossary.analogy: Biaya iklan dan sales untuk dapat pembeli, dibanding laba kotor yang dia sumbangkan.
glossary.definition: Customer Acquisition Cost dan bulan yang dibutuhkan gross profit pelanggan untuk memulihkan biaya akuisisi.
glossary.numbers: CAC Rp1,2jt, MRR Rp200rb, GM 75% -> payback 8 bulan.
glossary.check: Apa akibatnya kalau menghitung payback dari revenue bukan gross profit?

glossary.analogy: Berapa bulan perusahaan masih bisa hidup dengan uang di kas.
glossary.definition: Net cash burn per bulan dan estimasi bulan ketahanan kas, dengan asumsi dinyatakan jelas.
glossary.numbers: Kas Rp1,2M, burn Rp200jt/bln -> runway 6 bulan.
glossary.check: Kenapa runway tidak pasti jika penjualan berubah tiap bulan?

glossary.analogy: Harga rumah sebelum dan sesudah pemilik baru menyetor uang.
glossary.definition: Nilai perusahaan sebelum dan sesudah investasi primer dalam suatu financing.
glossary.numbers: Pre $8M, invest $2M -> post $10M.
glossary.check: Berapa ownership baru sebelum option-pool effects?

glossary.analogy: Kue perusahaan terbagi lebih banyak potongan setelah investor baru masuk.
glossary.definition: Catatan hak kepemilikan menurut kelas dan putaran; dilution terjadi ketika basis saham membesar.
glossary.numbers: Own 20%, lalu dilution pro-rata 20% -> stake turun menjadi 16% (simplified).
glossary.check: Mengapa 20% ownership tidak sama dengan 20% seluruh exit proceeds?

glossary.analogy: Sebelum ngasih uang, investor mengecek dokumen, pelanggan, produk dan risiko.
glossary.definition: Proses penyelidikan bukti bisnis, legal, keuangan, teknologi dan tim sebelum keputusan investasi.
glossary.numbers: Tiga diligence gates: cohort retention, data integrity, runway.
glossary.check: Apa satu temuan yang membuat keputusan 'pass'?

glossary.analogy: Surat ke komite berisi 'masuk atau enggak' beserta alasannya.
glossary.definition: Dokumen berstruktur berisi tesis, evidence, valuation, risiko, terms dan keputusan yang diusulkan.
glossary.numbers: Two-page memo memuat Invest/Pass/Further Diligence.
glossary.check: Mengapa ringkasan fitur produk saja bukan memo investasi?

glossary.analogy: Seperti dokter: diagnosis dahulu sebelum meresepkan obat.
glossary.definition: Merumuskan keputusan, kriteria, masalah dan hipotesis teruji sebelum menganalisis.
glossary.numbers: Goal: recover Rp600M profit loss in 90 days.
glossary.check: Apa risiko bila langsung merekomendasikan diskon?

glossary.analogy: Memecah penyebab bocor ember jadi lubang di sisi yang berbeda.
glossary.definition: Issue tree memecah pertanyaan utama menjadi driver relevan, sebisa mungkin saling terpisah dan mencakup masalah.
glossary.numbers: Profit=Volume×Price−Volume×UnitCost−FixedCost.
glossary.check: Apa cabang yang perlu ditambahkan jika pricing berubah?

glossary.analogy: Laba turun seperti saldo tabungan: apa kontribusi volume, harga dan biaya?
glossary.definition: Rekonsiliasi perubahan laba menurut driver operasi dan keuangan.
glossary.numbers: Prior Rp900jt; volume -Rp400jt; unit cost -Rp200jt -> Rp300jt.
glossary.check: Jika bridge tidak sampai current profit, apa yang harus diperiksa?

glossary.analogy: Diskon 10 ribu belum berarti laba naik; ada dampak balik dan biaya pelaksanaannya.
glossary.definition: Pendapatan dan biaya tambahan dari satu opsi dibanding baseline, net of incremental implementation costs.
glossary.numbers: 10rb cups×Rp18rb contribution−Rp60jt spend -> Rp120jt net.
glossary.check: Apa yang harus dicek sebelum mengasumsikan semua transaksi incremental?

glossary.analogy: Dua cara menghemat listrik jangan dihitung dua kali untuk lampu yang sama.
glossary.definition: Interaksi inisiatif membuat manfaat gabungan berbeda dari jumlah manfaat yang dihitung terpisah.
glossary.numbers: Penghematan Rp1rb per cup berlaku juga ke 10rb cup tambahan -> interaksi Rp10jt.
glossary.check: Kapan pengaruh silang ini justru negatif?

glossary.analogy: Judul slide adalah keputusan yang mau diambil, bukan label 'Analisis Pendapatan'.
glossary.definition: Judul slide mengomunikasikan kesimpulan yang ditopang exhibit teruji.
glossary.numbers: 'Falling volume explains two-thirds of profit decline' lebih informatif dari 'Volume'.
glossary.check: Apakah bukti di slide benar-benar membuktikan headline?

glossary.analogy: Ide bagus belum berguna kalau tak ada PIC, tenggat dan ukuran keberhasilannya.
glossary.definition: Rencana tindakan, pemilik, indikator, tanggal dan kriteria lanjut/hentikan.
glossary.numbers: Pilot 30 hari, KPI gross profit/customer experience, stop if quality falls.
glossary.check: Apa risiko dari KPI yang mudah dimanipulasi?

glossary.analogy: Belajar naik sepeda: nonton orang jago tidak sama dengan bisa mengayuh sendiri.
glossary.term: Worked Example / Deliberate Practice / Retrieval Practice
glossary.definition: Contoh pakar diikuti latihan mandiri, pengambilan ulang dari ingatan dan koreksi spesifik.
glossary.numbers: Lihat contoh, tutup contoh, bangun versi sendiri, lalu tes blind case.
glossary.check: Apakah lu bisa menjelaskan rumus sehari setelah menontonnya?

skills.check: No unsupported add-backs or double counting
Total Sources minus Total Uses exactly zero

skills.skill: Model debt amortization, cash sweep and interest

skills.proof: Equity cash flow and return schedule

Boundary price actually reproduces hurdle target

Model inputs cited and memo conclusion matches model

Defense: VC partner follow-up with milestone conditions

skills.skill: Distinguish problem, target customer and market
skills.check: TAM top-down does not masquerade as achievable revenue

skills.skill: Judge founder-market fit without invented claims
skills.check: No unsupported biographical assertions
Recurring and non-recurring cash receipts separate
Month-3 and month-6 cohorts not directly treated as same-age
Denominator, expansion and churn treatment explicit
Payback uses gross profit not raw revenue
Cash balance divided by disclosed net burn; scenario tested

skills.skill: Model pre/post money, cap table and dilution
skills.proof: Round closing and subsequent dilution schedule
skills.check: Ownership sums to 100%, entries reconcile
No confusion between startup valuation and fund IRR

skills.skill: Challenge market, competitive and execution assumptions
skills.check: 3 measurable investment gates
Decision supported by metric provenance

skills.skill: Defend investment under uncertainty and historical context
skills.check: No hindsight leakage in original underwriting

tracks.title: Strategy Consulting & Executive Problem Solving

benchmark.name: McKinsey official case interview practice
benchmark.role: recruitment practice case, not proof of real client project

stages: Independent: official practice case cold solve
Defense: 6-slide CEO decision and short oral Q&A

skills.skill: Clarify client objective and decision criterion
skills.check: Clear objective, timeframe and constraints
Branches relevant to case, no generic framework dumping
Denominator and reachable share separated
Bridge reconciles to reported profit movement

skills.skill: Separate observed effects from causal hypotheses
skills.check: No root cause asserted from arithmetic alone
Baseline/incremental calculations consistent
No double counting shared impact
Not merely pick highest gross benefit
Every title is a conclusion supported by exhibit
Metrics have owner, timing and stop/scale gate

skills.skill: Make explicit recommendation and decision ask
skills.check: Client can see exactly what must be approved
Responds to objections without canned frameworks

rubric.source: SELF INTERNAL PROPOSAL; NOT CFA, BVP, McKINSEY OR ANY EMPLOYER'S OFFICIAL SCORING

dimensions.desc: Model / numeric integrity, checks and formula logic
Defensible business decision, alternatives and tradeoffs
Executive clarity, traceability, concise action-oriented output

objective_checks: Sources and uses / ownership / profit bridge invariant
Correct file types and version retention
never_claim: expert approved without actual human reviewer
actual deal execution based on a synthetic case

training: Consistent synthetic source pack and source ledger
Guided workbook separate from blank workbook
Locked answer key not accessible in blind attempt
Verifiable calculations and intentional error traps
independent: Primary public source with precise publication date and page references
Genuinely new data to prevent answer memorization
No worked solution visibility until submission
failure_red_lines: Data from future of historical decision used in blind case
AI claiming numeric calculation done when never parsed original workbook
Missing sources or copyrighted work rehosted without permission
case_requirements.versioning: Case ID + version + dataset checksum + source date and access notes; submit immutable snapshots or version references.

gates.name: Case consistency and provenance
gates.proof: Case spec + source ledger + arithmetic golden sheet + independently checked expected outputs
gates.pass: No unlabelled unsupported figures and no unresolved arithmetic invariant

gates.name: Analogy + term + transfer
gates.proof: 3 sample lessons per track reviewed manually + new test questions
gates.pass: All teaching steps occur in order; naming rule always clear; analogies do not distort definitions

gates.name: Source to exhibit mapping
gates.proof: Exhibit screenshot/source pointer and exact page/section with rights status
gates.pass: All used claims grounded; missing preview honestly marked

gates.name: Deterministic formula QA
gates.proof: Unit tests incl intentionally broken workbook and expected failure
gates.pass: Deliberately altered formula flagged; no assertion of checking unparsed XLSX

gates.name: Blind independent assessment
gates.proof: New case + hidden answer key + defense questions and revision log
gates.pass: Assessment is not coached, answer leakage or unsupported automatic pass

gates.name: Recruiter-facing artifact review
gates.proof: Model + 2-page memo or 6 slide deck + assumption/source ledger
gates.pass: No fake credentials, defensible scope, files open and explainable

gates.name: Security/runtime/UX
gates.proof: GitHub CI + authenticated production browser test + two-owner RLS + real downloads
gates.pass: No unrelated regressions and no unverified live claims

current_verified_capabilities: Career Prep nav, curated source/video lists
3 sprint case content and downloadable practice assets
Private portfolio storage and self-attested checklist
GitHub CI for syntax/static workbook structure
present_weaknesses: 7 external preview references are not proof images render in production; 5/12 evidence still pointer-only
Most sources were title-level verified; deep page-level and rights audit incomplete
11 videos across 3 tracks; lesson-level post-watch exercises not consistently connected
Starter workbook formulas exist, but blind build and locked solution integrity not implemented
Uploads are stored privately; no real uploaded XLSX cell-by-cell automated QA
Self-reviewed label is not an expert/Director certification; no validated competency inference
CI confirms build but not production login, file lifecycle or learning efficacy
3-day synthetic cases are foundations, not automatically valid professional recruiting portfolio
